connector.name: pREST
connector.registryDescription: Stdio MCP adapter bridging AI clients to pREST's HTTP /_mcp endpoint for PostgreSQL APIs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image prest-mcp-adapter:0.1.3. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the prest account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PREST_MCP_URL
env.description: URL of your running pREST HTTP MCP endpoint, for example http://localhost:3000/_mcp

env.name: PREST_MCP_TOKEN
env.description: Optional bearer token used to authenticate with the pREST MCP endpoint.

env.name: PREST_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Optional HTTP timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.
